'''Surrel''' was<ref name="SWTOR" /> a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], in which they served as a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] in the military forces of the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Great]] [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]]. During the conflict Surrel worked selling light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] in in the market section of the [[House Organa (estate)|estate]] in the [[Apalis Coast]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Surrel had dark skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. While selling goods from a stall, Surrel carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and had a piece of silver-colored jewelry on their forehead.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Surrel appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Light Armor Vendor for Republic players on Alderaan.<ref name="SWTOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Surrel was removed from the game along with the rest of the Light Armor Vendors.<ref name="SWTOR" /> Their position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
